**Current transition and scope decision.** The operative [1.1.5 Task][task]
requests capture and presentation of these previously analysed decisions. The
proposed transition is **RAD-1.1.4 → RAD-1.1.5**, with migration as its intended
substance. This succeeds the historical reservation for 1.1.4-005; it neither
reopens the completed 004 governance result nor consumes another iteration of
that accepted transition. No 1.1.4-005 is created. Current maintained references
to that reservation may be updated under a later authorised application; immutable
completed records and original evidence retain their historical wording.

The complete analysed boundary includes 179 `/docs/markdown` sources, together
with 1,830 specialised ArchiMate workspace files and 134 correlated publication
files. DR-7 and DR-8 submit those companion moves explicitly for SA adjudication;
this request does not silently approve them. If 1.1.5 is to move only the Markdown
corpus, revise their dispositions and dependent path/validation treatments before
application. The preferred coherent scope remains the earlier analysed whole
mapping, with no additional architectural incorporation or extraction.

**Exact proposed map for this review:** use the unchanged [002 ledger][ledger]
plus the [59 explicit cell amendments][amendments]. Fifty-seven amendments change
only proposed `design/{review,register}/1.1.4/migration-inputs/` destinations to
`1.1.5` (52 review, five register). Existing 1.1.4 HCRLs and evidence stay at their
originating paths. The other two amendments propose DR-12's source/destination
locator correction. Each amendment identifies its one-based data-record number,
original source, field, exact old/new value and applicable DR. These data-record
numbers locate CSV rows; they create no new decision or identity taxonomy.
All other mapping cells remain inherited proposals. Original hash/size fields
remain historical fingerprints, not permission to apply stale source editions.
Use the recorded current editions under DR-12 and recheck again before application.
The 27 later tracked additions identified there are explicit Remain dispositions;
this review's own outputs are activity evidence, not additional migration sources.

**Decision sought:** confirm/correct the 1.1.4 → 1.1.5 transition, finite scope and
proposal semantics; adjudicate DR-2–DR-12 before authorising their dependent work.
The Task authorises this preparation, not relocation or architectural acceptance.
The root release stays 1.1.4 while pending. A separately instructed authorised
application would prepare the single 1.1.5 patch increment with
`bump --expect 1.1.4`, after rechecking the immediate accepted predecessor. No present Apply
instruction, completed migration HCRL or migrated baseline is claimed.
version `1.1.5` would record relocation, not a new historical approval.
